articles.title: SmallRig unveils S70 wireless microphone with 9 EQ presets, advanced noise cancellation, and 40 hours of battery life
articles.description: SmallRig has officially released the S70 wireless microphone globally. The company’s new wireless microphone is designed for content creators and professionals alike. It offers 48 kHz high-fidelity audio, a compact design, 3-level noise cancellation, 9 built-in EQ presets, app-based controls, and 40 hours of long battery life.
